# Clay Atlas

> A resource site protected by Cloudflare security services including email protection and bot prevention.

Clay Atlas leverages Cloudflare's security infrastructure to protect user communications and prevent automated access. The site requires JavaScript and implements email obfuscation for privacy.

## Key Topics

- Cloudflare
- Email Protection
- Bot Prevention
- Email Obfuscation
- JavaScript
- Cloudflare Security
- Web Security

## Security & Protection

- [Email Protection](https://clay-atlas.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection): Cloudflare email protection service for clay-atlas.com
